description: This file defines a Java class named CreateTaxGroupCommandHandler which handles the creation of tax groups within the Fineract project. It implements a command handler interface and interacts with the TaxWritePlatformService to process create commands for tax groups.

classes.name: CreateTaxGroupCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring service class that handles commands to create tax groups, delegating the creation logic to the TaxWritePlatformService.

methods.name: CreateTaxGroupCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the TaxWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the JSON command to create a tax group by calling the taxWritePlatformService.
